step.instruction: *I hope this message finds you well. I noticed that your machine is displaying an error indicating that the "dirty water reservoir on the robot itself is not in place." The success rate for this method is relatively high if you're willing to give it a shot:* *📝 Temporary Solution* *You can apply a small piece of tape (regular transparent tape will work) to the right side of the back of the main robot unit. This will help secure the dirty water reservoir detection sensor in the correct position.* *For visual guidance, please refer to the following link:* *If you encounter any issues during the process or prefer not to try this temporary solution, that's completely fine, and we will provide you with the relevant warranty service.*

step.title: What should I do when T2353 Omni E25/T2352 Omni E28 has 3021 Error: The sewage…
step.instruction: *I hope this message finds you well. I noticed that your machine is displaying an error indicating that the "dirty water reservoir on the robot itself is not in place." This issue may be caused by a slight misalignment of the detection sensor for the dirty water reservoir.* *Before arranging a replacement, we have a simple temporary solution that you might want to try. The success rate for this method is relatively high if you're willing to give it a shot:* *📝 Temporary Solution* *You can apply a small piece of tape (regular transparent tape will work) to the right side of the back of the main robot unit. This will help secure the dirty water reservoir detection sensor in the correct position.* *For visual guidance, please refer to the following link:* *If you encounter any issues during the process or prefer not to try this temporary solution, that's completely fine, and we will provide you with the relevant warranty service.*
step.expected_result: After this step, check whether the problem is resolved.

timeline.text: To check the warranty I'll need your order details. Please share your order number. If you bought it from another seller, please upload your proof of purchase showing the seller name, country of purchase and purchase date.
